items.title: Inside a Mysterious Village of Ghosts! 😨(Humans Not Allowed!)
items.description:
Deep in the Konkan region of Maharashtra lies a mysterious tradition that has been followed for generations… Gav Palan.

In Chinder village, once every year, something extraordinary happens — the entire village is left completely empty for three days. Homes are locked, streets are silent, and not a single person stays behind.

Why?

The villagers believe that during these three days, spirits and divine energies visit the village, and humans must step away to allow them to reside peacefully. Anyone who breaks this rule is believed to face serious consequences.

In this documentary, we travel to Chinder village to uncover the truth behind this centuries-old ritual. We speak to locals, hear stories passed down from ancestors, and explore the beliefs that keep this mysterious tradition alive even today.

What really happens in the village during those three days?
Is it faith, fear, or something beyond human understanding?

🎥 In this documentary you will see:
• The history and origin of Gav Palan
• Why the entire village leaves for 3 days
• Stories and beliefs of the villagers
• What happens if someone stays back
• The cultural and spiritual significance of this tradition

This is not just a story about a village… it’s a glimpse into a mysterious ritual that has survived for centuries.
